'''Leesub Sirln''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Qiraash]] who was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], conversing with others. Sirln had pale [[Color|pink]] skin, purple [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]].

==Biography==
Leesub Sirln was a [[Qiraash]]<ref name="Galactic Files" /> [[Gender|female]]<ref name="BTS" /> who was pursued by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] authorities during the [[Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Galactic Files" /> between the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> The Empire suspected Sirln of being [[Force-sensitive]], although she in fact lacked any [[The Force|Force]] sensitivity and simply possessed [[Precognition|precognitive]] abilities.<ref name="Galactic Files" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> Sirln was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and former [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered with the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Sirln had light skin, [[Color|purple]] [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Skills and abilities==
Sirln had precognitive powers and possessed average fighting abilities, diplomatic skill, strength, speed, and intelligence.<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
While at the [[cantina]], Sirln wore a silver and black [[Clothing|leotard]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Leesub Sirln was played by actress [[Pam Rose]] in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. [[Graham Freeborn]] applied the make-up for the character, who was known only as "Weird Girl" during production.<ref name="BTS" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], she was first identified on a card released in [[2016]] on the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app.<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 3|cardname=Leesub Sirln}}</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[1995]] [[Premiere Limited]] set of cards for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Leesub Sirln}}</ref>
